propositions: Dependabot PR #131 must be landed via Gerrit rather than GitHub because the repository uses Gerrit for all main-branch changes and GitHub is read-only.

The lock upgrade resolves five packages to versions ahead of what the PR originally pinned: botocore 1.43.75 (vs 1.43.72), genai-prices 0.1.4 (vs 0.1.3), json-repair 0.63.3 (vs 0.63.2), with mypy 2.3.1 and ruff 0.16.3 matching the PR.
Lint and typecheck gates under new ruff 0.16.3 and mypy 2.3.1 must pass without adding suppressions or rule exclusions; the complexity ratchet must show zero new or increased violations.
The Gerrit change must receive LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 votes, be submitted without unresolved comments, and merge to main; the merged commit sha must be recorded.
PR #131 must be confirmed closed after the mirror syncs, either via dependabot auto-close or manual closure with cross-reference to the Gerrit change and merged commit.
